title: Luxuriant Tender Korean Noodles Skillet
description: A sour, tender, and indulgent Korean dish featuring salted butter and macrobiotic-friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection in a cast-iron skillet.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the Korean noodles according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Gochujang, soy sauce, and rice vinegar.
Heat the sesame oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to coat with the sesame oil.
Pour the Gochujang mixture over the noodles and stir to combine.
Add the salted butter to the skillet and stir until melted and well combined.
Sprinkle the chopped green onions, toasted sesame seeds, and crushed red pepper over the top of the noodles.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the noodles are well coated and the sauce is bubbly.
